_comment: Migration snapshot (Phase 0, 2026-06-06): campaigns that existed BEFORE the compliance gate was hardened to be un-downgradable. Consumed by scripts/lib/human-override.mjs. A campaign listed here keeps its pre-existing campaigns/<slug>/validation.config.json relaxations HONORED (we don't retroactively un-protect already-shipped work — see the 2026-06-04 plan-2 grandfather). A campaign NOT listed here gets the hard, fail-closed gate: any relaxing validation.config.json it drops is IGNORED, and --force-unsafe is refused, unless Cody sets the out-of-band marker AA_HUMAN_OVERRIDE=<slug> in his own terminal. Do NOT hand-add new campaigns to grandfather them — that re-opens the master-key hole; fix the work or use the marker instead. repurpose-campaign.mjs may append a 1:1 clone of an already-grandfathered SOURCE (inherited grandfather only).
